modalLead: A third block for the outside world: your feeds, as headlines you can click. Give one block a handful of feed addresses and it lists the newest articles across all of them, with the rest a click away.

items.text: An RSS block that shows the articles themselves. The Feeds block tells you a feed has something new; this one tells you what it is. Paste a handful of feed addresses into the block — one per line, up to ten — and it lists the newest headlines across all of them, newest first. Each headline opens the article, and the block keeps itself up to date while the page is open.

Hover a headline for the whole entry. A headline is cut to one line so a block stays a block. Rest the pointer on it — or reach it with the arrow keys — and the full title, the feed's own summary, where it came from and how old it is appear beside the row, and go again when you move away.

Show more, without leaving the page. You choose how many rows the block shows; anything past that folds into a more row. Open it and the rest unfold in place, and the block remembers you opened it. Headlines can be walked with the arrow keys like every other row, and Ctrl/Cmd+Enter opens one in a new tab.
